{"diagnosis":"Batch 14 was re-delivered at 05:00 with 338 rows duplicating the 02:00 rows. The copies differ only in txn_ts (epoch milliseconds as text) and ingest_ts. The cast fails on the epoch strings. 1768716261000 equals 2026-01-18 06:04:21 UTC, which matches the original copy, so the fix is to parse both formats and keep one row per txn_id.","decision":"fix","confidence":0.9,"pre_sql":[],"step_overrides":{"silver_transactions":"CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS
WITH parsed AS (
  SELECT txn_id, customer_id, merchant_id, amount, status, ingest_ts,
         CASE WHEN regexp_matches(txn_ts, '^[0-9]{13}$') THEN epoch_ms(CAST(txn_ts AS BIGINT))
              ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS ts
  FROM raw_transactions
),
dedup AS (
  SELECT *, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_id ORDER BY ingest_ts, ts) AS rn
  FROM parsed
)
SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id,
       customer_id,
       CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id,
       CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount,
       CAST(ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts,
       CAST(CAST(ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date
FROM dedup
WHERE rn = 1 AND status = 'POSTED';"}}
